reason: The budget and loop guard speak directly to my fear, and the free self-hosted version on my spare Mac mini costs me nothing to try. But it is pre-alpha from one developer, so I would tinker with the free version before I pay $99 a month for anything.
objection: If a pre-alpha tool built by one person has a bug in its own budget guard, it burns our agent quota overnight anyway, and nobody is around to answer when it breaks.
would_change_my_mind: A few weeks of the free version on my Mac mini that show the cost caps really stop runs, plus a second maintainer or a few agencies like mine using it.
